item.title: Opinion: CDC shift on vaccine-autism guidance puts families, communities at risk
item.description: When trusted voices like the CDC send mixed signals, the ripple effects are immediate. Families pause, delay or decline vaccines. As a result, we now have the increasing spread of diseases like measles, pertussis and meningitis.
